name: Blue
source:
A mysterious guy who appears on a stormy night who can wield a strange power.
He loves nature but despises humanity.
He despairs that humanity has polluted the world and wants to destroy everything.
His name was given to him by [url=/c46987]Marine[/url] who he met when he was a child.
